subject: Leadership succession & performance calibration: proposal and confidential asks
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Lowe <erin.lowe@peopleops.co>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership succession & performance calibration: proposal and confidential asks

Team —

I am sharing a confidential proposal for a small leadership reshuffle and a parallel performance calibration exercise for the senior engineering ladder. This is time-sensitive: please treat as "confidential — leadership review" while we finalize HR input. Attached: org-chart-v2.pdf and calibration-matrix.xlsx.

High-level summary:
- Proposal: Move two cross-functional squads (Runtime & Serving Core) under a single Senior Lead role to reduce coordination overhead and improve runway for our compilation roadmap.
- Succession: We are proposing an internal candidate pool for the Senior Lead seat (no names in this thread). The plan includes a phased handover over 6–8 weeks to preserve project continuity.
- Performance calibration: We need to run a targeted calibration for 6 senior+ ICs who are being considered for management stretches or individual contributor promotions. The attached matrix highlights performance signals, recent 1:1 summaries, and suggested risk mitigations.

Asks (please):
1) Marcus — confirm technical scope overlap is accurate in the attached org chart and whether the proposed single-lead model introduces any immediate throughput risk.
2) Aditya — confirm whether the proposed changes are materially relevant to our hiring/hiring freeze guidance and any compensation sensitivity we should account for.
3) Lauren — can you engage PeopleOps (Erin) on pay equity and promotion timeline guidance? We need HR sign-off before any manager-level notices go out.
4) All — please avoid wider distribution. I will hold a short sync after your initial replies to lock the plan and comms.

Key constraints:
- No public comms until HR and Legal clearance (rough ETA 72 hours).
- Headcount is not increasing; some role scopes will be rebalanced (title changes possible).

Next steps: receive feedback by EOD today 12/09 if possible. I will consolidate and set a 30-minute decision call.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org-chart-v2.pdf (org chart with dotted handover annotations), calibration-matrix.xlsx (candidate signals, risk notes)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Thanks, Olga — quick read and two initial comments.

On Wed, Dec 9, 2026 at 08:12 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> I am sharing a confidential proposal for a small leadership reshuffle and a parallel performance calibration exercise for the senior engineering ladder...

1) Org chart: The consolidation of Runtime & Serving Core under one Senior Lead makes sense from a dependency perspective. The main risk is peak delivery windows in Q1 (model compilation milestones) — we should preserve a dedicated delivery lead for the next quarter. I annotated org-chart-v2 with two dashed "delivery lead" roles.

2) Calibration: The matrix is well structured. Two notes:
- Candidate C (row 4) has a recent upward trajectory but limited people-management experience; recommend a 3-month acting assignment before promotion.
- Candidate F (row 6) has an outstanding technical record but ongoing performance-concern flagged in Q2 2026 — suggest a targeted performance plan alongside any title change.

I am happy to review the candidate notes in a quick follow-up. If we can tighten the handover plan for the first 4 weeks, I think throughput risk is manageable.

Marcus
Sr Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (annotation) org-chart-v2.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Lowe <erin.lowe@peopleops.co>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership succession & performance calibration: proposal and confidential asks

Olga — appreciate the heads up and the materials. Two pragmatic items from Finance/Leadership perspective:

- Compensation sensitivity: promotions to Senior Manager/Director often require a comp uplift that needs approval from the compensation committee. Please flag any candidates you intend to promote in this cycle. If possible, include an expected comp band in the calibration matrix to speed review.

- Credits / SLAs: If the consolidation changes model-inference SLAs for customer tiers we should identify any top-10 accounts that may be affected and run a quick risk assessment before comms.

I recommend we loop in PeopleOps for pay-equity clearance, then present a consolidated recommendation to Exec (30-min slot). Happy to block time after EOD 12/09.

—Aditya
VP Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Dec 9, 2026 at 10:05 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Olga — quick read and two initial comments...

Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership succession & performance calibration: proposal and confidential asks

Hi all — thanks for the invite and the materials. I attached consultant-notes.txt with a short read on sensitive comms and promotion pacing. High-level:

- Timing: HR prefers a minimal notice period for leadership role changes (two-week heads-up to cross-functional partners, formal manager notices after HR sign-off).
- Promotions: For senior-level promotion, we recommend a small calibration panel (Aditya/Marcus + two peers + PeopleOps rep). Keep promotion offers conditional on a 3-month success review where appropriate.
- Pay equity: We will run a pay-equity scan against market bands and internal comparators; expect 48–72 hours for initial results.

I will prepare a short template for manager notices and a checklist for confidential comms.

Best,
Erin Lowe
Principal Consultant, PeopleOps Consultancy

Attachment: consultant-notes.txt (comm plan + template)
